salmanshh_dhtn_agent.name: Utility-Driven HTN (Hierarchical Task Network) Agent
salmanshh_dhtn_agent.description: Give any object smart AI, attach this behavior and it automatically registers with the HTN Manager, runs utility-scored planning, tracks alert tiers, reacts to sight/sound/damage signals, and fires clean event-sheet triggers for each task. No AI boilerplate, no per-instance glue code. Supports squads, slot-based tactical coordination, temporary task overrides, save/load, and performance scaling for any game size.

agentType.name: Agent Type
agentType.desc: Selects which AI network this object uses. Use case: assign "grunt" to basic enemies and "boss" to bosses.

planningMode.name: Planning Mode
planningMode.desc: Sets when planning runs. Use case: choose deliberate for many background NPCs to reduce CPU usage.

planningIntervalSec.name: Planning Interval (sec)
planningIntervalSec.desc: Time in seconds between periodic replans. Use case: set 0.5 for responsive guards, 2.0 for idle crowds.

urgencyThreshold.name: Urgency Threshold
urgencyThreshold.desc: Urgency needed to replan instantly in hybrid mode. Use case: keep low for stealth games that need quick reactions.

initialAlertLevel.name: Initial Alert Level
initialAlertLevel.desc: Starting alert value from 0 to 1. Use case: begin ambush enemies at 0.6 so they start suspicious.

taskTimeoutSec.name: Task Timeout (sec)
taskTimeoutSec.desc: Auto-fails a stuck task after this many seconds. Use case: set 8 to recover if pathing gets blocked.

autoRegister.name: Auto Register
autoRegister.desc: Registers with the manager on spawn. Use case: disable for cutscene actors you register later by events.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Turns this behavior processing on or off. Use case: disable far-away enemies to save performance.

debugLabel.name: Debug Label
debugLabel.desc: Optional name shown in warnings. Use case: set "Guard_North" to quickly identify problem agents.

AssignAgentToSquad.description: Adds an agent to a squad and syncs squad world-state keys.

AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.list-name: Coordination: Auto Assign Nearest Free Slot
AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.display-text: Auto assign nearest free {2} slot in squad {1} to agent UID {0} from ({3}, {4}) within {5} with ttl {6} sec
AutoAssignNearestFreeSlot.description: Finds nearest free slot and reserves it for the agent.

ClearSquadStateKey.description: Clears one shared squad state key.

InvalidateSquadPlans.description: Marks squad plans stale so they are replanned on coordination pass.

LoadSlotPositionsFromJSON.list-name: Coordination: Load Slot Positions From JSON
LoadSlotPositionsFromJSON.display-text: Load slot positions for type {1} in squad {0} from JSON {2}
LoadSlotPositionsFromJSON.description: Imports slot coordinates from a JSON array string.

slotsJson.name: Slots JSON
slotsJson.desc: JSON array with slot ids and positions.

LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.list-name: Coordination: Load Slot Positions From World State Key
LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.display-text: Load slot positions for type {1} in squad {0} from world key {3} using scope {2} and UID {4}
LoadSlotPositionsFromWorldStateKey.description: Loads JSON slot positions from a world-state key and imports them.

agentUID.name: Agent UID
agentUID.desc: Source agent UID when scope is Agent UID.

ReleaseSlot.display-text: Release slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0}
ReleaseSlot.description: Releases a slot reservation if present.

RemoveAgentFromSquad.description: Removes an agent from its current squad and releases owned slots.

RequestSquadPlans.description: Requests immediate plan updates for all squad members.

ReserveSlot.display-text: Reserve slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} for agent UID {3} with ttl {4} sec
ReserveSlot.description: Reserves a squad slot for an agent if free or expired.

SetCoordinationAutoReleaseOnDeregister.list-name: Coordination: Set Auto Release On Deregister
SetCoordinationAutoReleaseOnDeregister.display-text: Set auto release on deregister to {0}
SetCoordinationAutoReleaseOnDeregister.description: Controls whether owned slots are auto-released when agents are deregistered.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True enables auto release on deregister.

SetCoordinationEnabled.description: Enables or disables squad coordination processing globally.

SetCoordinationMaxSquadsPerUpdate.list-name: Coordination: Set Max Squads Per Update
SetCoordinationMaxSquadsPerUpdate.display-text: Set max squads per coordination update to {0}
SetCoordinationMaxSquadsPerUpdate.description: Caps number of squads processed per coordination pass. 0 means all.

SetCoordinationSlotDefaultTtl.display-text: Set slot default ttl to {0} sec
SetCoordinationSlotDefaultTtl.description: Sets default reservation TTL in seconds for slot operations.

SetCoordinationTimeSlice.display-text: Set coordination time slice to {0} sec
SetCoordinationTimeSlice.description: Sets optional time slice cap per coordination pass. 0 disables slice.

SetCoordinationUpdateInterval.display-text: Set coordination update interval to {0} sec
SetCoordinationUpdateInterval.description: Sets global coordination update interval in seconds.

SetSlotPosition.display-text: Set slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} to ({3}, {4})
SetSlotPosition.description: Stores world position for a squad slot.

SetSlotReservation.display-text: Set slot reservation mode {0} for squad {1}, type {2}, slot {3}, agent UID {4}, ttl {5} sec
SetSlotReservation.description: Combined slot reservation control for reserve or release modes.

SetSquadLeader.display-text: Set squad {0} leader to agent UID {1}
SetSquadLeader.description: Sets one leader UID for the squad.

SetSquadStateKey.description: Writes one shared squad state key and mirrors it to squad members.

SquadPlanControl.display-text: Squad plan control mode {0} for squad {1}
SquadPlanControl.description: Combined squad plan control for invalidate, request, or both.

SetAgentType.description: Switches this object to another AI profile and replans. Use case: turn a civilian into a guard during an alarm.

agentType.name: Agent Type
agentType.desc: Task network id to use for this instance.

SetEnabled.description: Turns this agent processing on or off. Use case: disable distant enemies to save CPU.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: True to process AI, false to stop processing.

SetPlanningInterval.description: Sets periodic planning time in seconds. Use case: increase to 2 seconds for background NPCs to reduce CPU.

SetPlanningMode.description: Changes when this agent replans. Use case: use reactive mode for bosses that must react instantly.

SetProcessingInterval.description: Sets how often periodic planning runs in seconds. Use case: raise to 2 seconds for low-priority NPCs.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.desc: Interval in seconds between periodic planning updates.

SetTaskTimeout.description: Sets auto-fail timeout in seconds for stuck tasks. Use case: recover agents stuck behind obstacles.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.desc: Timeout in seconds. Use 0 to disable.

SignalDamaged.description: Reports damage and updates related world-state values. Use case: trigger retreat behavior when health drops.

SignalSoundHeard.description: Reports a sound event for hearing reactions. Use case: alert nearby guards when player makes noise.

SignalTargetLost.description: Marks target as no longer visible. Use case: call when line-of-sight breaks.

SignalTargetSeen.display-text: Signal target seen UID {0} at ({1}, {2}) with confidence {3}
SignalTargetSeen.description: Reports visual contact and updates target data. Use case: call when enemy raycast detects player.

ClearTemporaryTask.description: Stops temporary override and returns to normal planning. Use case: end cutscene idle behavior early.

MarkTaskComplete.description: Marks current task as done so plan can continue. Use case: call after reaching a patrol waypoint.

MarkTaskFailed.description: Marks current task as failed to force replanning. Use case: call when pathfinding cannot reach target.

Pause.description: Pauses AI updates for this object. Use case: freeze enemies during pause menu or dialogue.

PushTemporaryTask.description: Runs a one-off task before returning to normal plan. Use case: force "idle" during a short cutscene.

durationSec.name: Duration (sec)
durationSec.desc: Override duration in seconds. Use 0 for manual completion.

RequestReplan.description: Requests an immediate replan now. Use case: call right after a major world-state change.

Resume.description: Resumes AI updates and replans immediately. Use case: wake enemies when player enters the area.

ClearTarget.description: Removes current target data for this agent. Use case: clear chase data after the player escapes.

ClearWorldStateKey.list-name: World State: Clear World State Key
ClearWorldStateKey.description: Deletes one world-state key on this agent. Use case: clear a temporary flag like "heardNoise".

SetPatrolPoint.description: Stores a patrol waypoint in world state. Use case: set patrol routes at layout start from events.

SetTarget.description: Sets target UID and position in one step. Use case: lock onto player when entering attack range.

SetWorldState.description: Writes any custom world-state key for this agent. Use case: set "hasCover" after finding cover.

IsAgentInSquad.description: True if the agent is currently assigned to the given squad.

IsSlotFree.display-text: Is slot {2} of type {1} in squad {0} free
IsSlotFree.description: True if the slot is not currently reserved by a live owner.

IsSquadLeader.description: True if the agent is the current leader of its squad.

OnSlotReleased.description: Triggered when a slot reservation is released or expires.

OnSlotReserved.description: Triggered when a slot reservation succeeds.

OnSquadMembershipChanged.description: Triggered when an agent joins or leaves a squad.

OnSquadStateChanged.description: Triggered when a squad shared state key is updated or cleared.

OnAlertChanged.description: Runs when alert tier changes. Use case: switch sprite animation from patrol to combat.

OnPlanFailed.description: Runs when no valid plan is found. Use case: force a safe fallback task like idle.

OnStimulusReceived.description: Runs when a signal is received. Use case: play an exclamation sound when enemy hears noise.

OnTaskCompleted.description: Runs after task completion is marked. Use case: start movement for the next task.

OnTaskFailed.description: Runs after task failure is marked. Use case: play a failed path reaction before retry.

OnTaskStarted.description: Runs when a new primitive task starts. Use case: branch event logic by CurrentTask.

OnTemporaryTaskEnded.description: Runs when temporary override ends. Use case: resume normal patrol animation.

OnTemporaryTaskStarted.description: Runs when temporary override starts. Use case: force a guard to hold position briefly.

HasActivePlan.description: True when this agent still has work to do. Use case: skip idle logic while a plan is active.

HasTarget.description: True when a visible target is set. Use case: only run chase movement when target exists.

HasWorldState.description: True if a world-state key exists. Use case: check if patrol data was set before using it.

IsAlerted.description: True for alerted or combat tiers. Use case: enable weapon behavior only at high alert.

IsAlertTier.description: True when alert tier matches selected value. Use case: run separate logic for suspicious vs combat.

IsEnabled.description: True when this behavior is processing. Use case: skip AI movement events when disabled.

IsExecuting.description: True when current task matches the id. Use case: run patrol code only during task "patrol".

IsInCombat.description: True only at combat tier. Use case: start firing logic only when fully engaged.

IsInTemporaryTask.description: True while temporary task override is active. Use case: block normal task completion events during cutscenes.

IsPaused.description: True when Pause was applied. Use case: avoid sending duplicate pause commands.

AgentSquad.description: Returns the squad id for an agent UID.

AssignedSlotId.description: Returns slot id assigned to an agent for the slot type.

CoordinationEnabled.description: Returns 1 if coordination processing is enabled, else 0.

CoordinationIntervalSec.description: Returns coordination update interval in seconds.

CoordinationPassesThisTick.description: Returns number of coordination squads processed in last pass.

CoordinationTimeSliceSec.description: Returns coordination time slice cap in seconds.

CountSquadAgents.description: Returns member count for a squad.

ExpiredSlotsReleased.description: Returns total number of expired slot releases.

GetSquadAgentUIDByIndex.description: Returns squad member UID at a zero-based index.

SlotOwner.description: Returns current owner UID for a slot, or 0 if free.

SquadLeader.description: Returns leader UID for a squad.

SquadStateValue.description: Returns one squad state value by key.

AgentType.description: Returns this agent type id. Use case: show current AI profile in a debug panel.

AlertLevel.description: Returns alert level from 0 to 1. Use case: drive UI color intensity for enemy awareness.

AlertTier.description: Returns alert tier index. Use case: switch behavior branches with a numeric tier check.

AlertTierName.description: Returns alert tier name text. Use case: print "suspicious" or "combat" to debug text.

CompletedTask.description: Returns last completed task id. Use case: log finished tasks for tuning AI flow.

CurrentTask.description: Returns current task id. Use case: route event-sheet logic by active task name.

Enabled.description: Returns 1 if enabled, else 0. Use case: show current AI processing state in a debug text object.

FailedTask.description: Returns last failed task id. Use case: track tasks that frequently fail and need redesign.

LastKnownX.description: Returns last known target X. Use case: move to investigate where the player was seen.

LastKnownY.description: Returns last known target Y. Use case: move to investigate where the player was seen.

PlanLength.description: Returns remaining task count. Use case: detect empty plans and request fallback behavior.

PlanTaskAtIndex.description: Returns task id at a plan index. Use case: preview next task for debugging.

PreviousTask.description: Returns previous task id. Use case: detect transitions like patrol to chase.

PreviousTier.description: Returns previous alert tier index. Use case: trigger one-time effects on tier changes.

RestoredTask.description: Returns task restored after temporary override. Use case: continue a paused patrol task cleanly.

StimulusIntensity.description: Returns latest stimulus intensity. Use case: scale reaction strength from weak to strong.

StimulusType.description: Returns latest stimulus type text. Use case: handle sound and damage with different responses.

StimulusX.description: Returns latest stimulus X position. Use case: face toward the source of a sound.

StimulusY.description: Returns latest stimulus Y position. Use case: move to inspect where damage came from.

TargetUID.description: Returns current target UID. Use case: fetch target instance for aim or movement logic.

WorldState.description: Reads a world-state value by key. Use case: check custom flags like "isCoverAvailable" in events.
